dimensions.dimension: Citation Faithfulness (claims supported by cited pages)

scoringMethod: Run each golden question through the deep-researcher agent (N>=3). Layer 1: automated checks - URL liveness, contract lint (7 headers, <800 body tokens, zero preamble), confidence-vs-domain-count (HIGH requires >=3 distinct orgs), factual exact-match, fabrication kill-check (GS-4), freshness regex, banned-egress scan (GS-5). Layer 2: judge verifies faithfulness via WebFetch and correlation quality. HARD-VETO: fabricated URL as live cite, invented specifics on GS-4, HIGH on single source for contested claim, any private-individual data on GS-5. Promote only if no vetoes and no regression on automated dims.
